parsed.rationale: Three separate packages — DebugPanel and Wallpaper (twice, once in a sample-app file and once in production throttling code) — each declare an unnamed extension on ProcessInfo.ThermalState at lines 212, 236, and 230 respectively. Because the extensions are unnamed and carry no recorded fields or signatures, the most likely scenario is that each adds the same convenience members (e.g., a display-string or ordering helper) to the system type. Consolidating into a single extension in DebugPanel (which already owns the canonical debug-metrics surface) and having Wallpaper import DebugPanel — or, if that dependency direction is undesirable, extracting to a shared utility package — eliminates the three-way shadow. The Wallpaper sample-app copy at DebugHUD.swift is the lowest-value duplicate and should be the first to be deleted.
